core.notes:
The one-time reset of your module list now gives you every feature that is on at install (it stopped after the first one when several were), and does not carry your old list's order back in
The welcome tour starts with two plain pages: what a Module, Tool and Tweak are and where to find them, then what the AWOO+ menu, the Control Panel and the top bar buttons each do (and that AWOO+ is built to be light). The Appearance step is gone, and the tour ends with a short Control Panel guide that rings the tabs, Enabled / Menu / Bar and the Feature settings list on the real panel
Control Panel: the Features switch is headed Enabled (it said On); names in Feature settings that have no settings of their own are greyed (still clickable); General credits Apoz as the author of AWOO+
This update resets your menu order, which modules are switched on, and which are in the AWOO+ menu to the defaults, once. Switch back on what you use: Control Panel › Features. Settings you changed inside a feature are kept
Control Panel: the Feature settings list in the sidebar can be folded, and starts folded
Sync now has its own read allowance, so pressing it after a busy hour still reads your sculpture grids and skill trees
Control Panel › Changelog groups each version's changes under categories (Control Panel, Menu & top bar, Look & themes, Profile Sync, Tools, Modules & Tweaks, Updates & install), always in the same order. A Tweak can now add its own tab beside the AWOO+ changelog
Partners tool: Efficient now picks the ratio where resources times drops per day is largest (the same answer whichever ratio you compare against); Partner and Pet investment are one two-sided Invest button; more room above the Investment tab
Sync now also reads your shattered gold
The menu is now three columns when wide: Modules, Tools, Tweaks. Tweaks are no longer listed by default: the Tweaks column links to the new Tweaks page, and pointing at it lists what is switched on. Tick Menu on a Tweak to add it. Features are sorted by channel (public, village, trusted, dev) everywhere, the coloured dots are bigger, and the menu has no icons
Control Panel: Modules and Tweaks are separate tabs again, and the settings list in the sidebar shows only the features that are loaded
Notifications can now appear at the bottom middle of the screen
The WIP tag no longer vanishes from a menu row when you point at it. The "what do the marks mean" key lists only the channels you actually have
Tooltips show again (they had stopped appearing); the "may have been blocked by the popup blocker" notice now opens the tool in a new tab instead of replacing the game; AWOO+ no longer starts a second copy inside a page the game shows within itself, such as its Documentation tab
Sharper lines and a lighter Control Panel; Modules, Tweaks and Tools get small icons in the menu; three new themes (Tyrian, Slate Green, Indigo); a new Appearance › Tooltips tab sets tip delays and position, and clicking a pop-up keeps it open so you can drag it
When an update is ready, a green Update button shines on the top bar. Click it to install, reload, see what changed, or be reminded tomorrow
AWOO+ can now also be installed as a single script from a personal link, and its Updates page and diagnostics understand that copy
New setting under Appearance › Fonts › Number format: Large numbers. Choose letters from a million like the game (the default), letters from a thousand (834k), or every digit; the history pages use it
AWOO+ hover panels now sit under AWOO+ tips, so a tip inside a panel is never hidden behind it, and they close the moment your mouse leaves them
Features still being tested carry a small WIP tag beside their name: in the Control Panel, the top-bar menu and their window or page
After this update your menu, top bar and which features are loaded start over once from the new defaults (your bar size is kept): re-pick what you use in the Control Panel or the setup wizard
The coloured dots in the menu are all one size, and the channel colours match the rest of AWOO+: dev teal, trusted blue, village violet, public amber
Cost Tables: Sync now also fills your sanctum skill-tree points and your Repeater cave tool level
Profile Sync: Stat Boosts was always empty. It is now Battle Boosts and holds your crit chance and damage, multistrike, healing, attack speed and gathering boosts, filled by Sync now. Income Multipliers is gone: it was a copy of four numbers already in All Multipliers
The Control Panel has a minimise button (the _ next to the close X). It tucks the panel into a Control Panel button in the top bar, and a click brings it back on the page you were on
Dungeon Win Rate: Its entry in Control Panel › Feature settings is greyed, because it has no settings of its own
